findings.description: Duplicate beam number B12 in the beam schedule (2 rows)
findings.explanation: Rows have CONFLICTING data - bottom: 3-16T | 4-20T; depth: 450 | 600; stirrups: 8T@150 | 8T@125; top: 2-16T | 3-20T; width: 230 | 300
findings.reason: Same identifier repeated within the schedule with different design values
findings.recommended_action: Delete the redundant row or give the conflicting beam its own number.

findings.description: Potential floor-level mismatch between titles in the same drawing
findings.explanation: Titles refer to different floor/slab levels. Dominant level: 1. All titles: "BEAM SCHEDULE AT FIRST SLAB LEVEL" [beam schedule] -> level 1; "SLAB SCHEDULE AT FIRST SLAB LEVEL" [slab schedule] -> level 1; "COLUMN SCHEDULE AT FIRST SLAB LEVEL" [slab schedule] -> level 1; "RCC DETAILS OF FIRST SLAB LEVEL" [sheet] -> level 1; "LAYOUT AT SECOND SLAB LEVEL" [layout] -> level 2
findings.reason: Different level words/ordinals found in titles that should describe the same level
findings.recommended_action: Check which floor the sheet is for and correct the conflicting title(s). Set 'single_floor_per_drawing' in the profile if this file holds several floors.

findings.description: Column number C2 used at 2 locations

findings.reason: Same identifier at multiple distinct positions in one layout
findings.recommended_action: Confirm the numbering convention; renumber duplicates if identifiers must be unique.

findings.recommended_action: Remove the duplicate or give the different column its own number.

findings.description: Beam numbers: 'B2' is smaller than the inferred standard

findings.reason: Height differs from inferred reference by more than 1%
